text.text_excerpt: The InterContinental is an old school New Orleans hotel. While not the newest or fanciest hotel in the CBD, it is classy and elegant. I had the pleasure of staying here over a weekend in late June of this year. When I was looking for a room, I used Hotwire so my hotel name wasn't known till after I booked. When I realized it was the InterContinental, I didn't know what to expect. Once I checked in I realized I was in for a treat. Valet parking was very easy and it's located under a large overhang which shelters you from the weather. The front desk and lobby are located on the second level and are easily accessible by escalator. The lobby and front desk area show their age and I was a litt...

We really liked this hotel; we almost always stay in the CBD, but this was our first time at the InterContinental. Excellent location, though auto traffic around the hotel can make for some slow moving to get there. Our room was very comfortable and quiet, high quality toiletries, very clean, very helpful staff. Only two minor complaints: no newspapers or awareness of where to find one, and valet parking car retrieval was very slow (and pricy, but I knew ahead that it would be $47).

Intercontinental is a great hotel chain, and this outpost lives up to the chain's fantastic reputation. The hotel had been recently updated so I had been meaning to check it out and this last weekend finally did. It was updated two years ago! Time flies for sure. Anyways, I stayed over for a night to have a relaxing staycation. Glad I did. Check-in was a breeze, with everyone being friendly and efficient. The room itself was luxurious and mine had a balcony. Since was decent, with a nice entryway. Bathroom products were fancy and the shower head was one of the better ones I have experienced at a hotel.
